text: Which of the following principle is established under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC)?
opta: A. Equal responsibility for all nations regardless of development status
optb: B. Exclusive responsibility of developing nations to reduce emissions
optc: C. Voluntary participation without institutional oversight
optd: D. Common but differentiated responsibilities among countries
answer: D. Common but differentiated responsibilities among countries

text: The temperature goal of the Paris Agreement is:
optc: C. Limit warming to well below 2°C, aiming for 1.5°C
answer: C. Limit warming to well below 2°C, aiming for 1.5°C

text: According to the International Court of Justice, what is a key obligation of states under international law?
opta: A. To prioritize economic growth over environmental protection
optb: B. To prevent significant harm to the climate system
optc: C. To act only within their own borders
optd: D. To avoid cooperating with other countries
answer: B. To prevent significant harm to the climate system

text: The ICJ’s statement that all countries must reduce emissions reflects which type of obligation?
opta: A. Legal duty under international law
answer: A. Legal duty under international law

text: What role does the ICJ opinion play in international climate negotiations?
opta: A. It sets binding emission targets
optb: B. It reduces the need for agreements
optc: C. It strengthens the legal basis for more ambitious action
optd: D. It only applies to Pacific Island countries
answer: C. It strengthens the legal basis for more ambitious action
